adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` changed the fallback from `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. But that fallback branch only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so the `.find(...)` compares `cal.externalId === undefined/null` and will almost always return `undefined`. This prevents using the event’s destination calendar when no `externalCalendarId` is provided (e.g., older references), causing updates/deletes to target the default (`primary`) or an undefined calendarId rather than the actual calendar where the event was created.
